description: Show what is in a .glb or .gltf, without Godot: file size, triangles, nodes, materials, textures with a memory estimate, the size in metres and the lowest point, then the node tree with triangles per mesh. `detail` brief lists the first 40 nodes; full lists every node, the materials and the textures. Use it for the numbers, for example to check a triangle budget or why a model floats. Read-only. To see the shape use godot_model_view; to find problems use godot_model_lint.

detail.description: brief (capped lists) or full (everything); default brief

file.description: Path to a .glb or .gltf file, inside the project.

name: godot_model_inspect
title: Inspect a 3D model
